{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id by keeping the row with the highest sample_seq per patient
data_dedup = data.loc[data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Now compute the fraction of patients with severe baseline disease
total_patients = len(data_dedup)
severe_patients = (data_dedup['severity'] == 'severe').sum()
fraction_severe = severe_patients / total_patients

print(f'Total deduplicated patients: {total_patients}')
print(f'Patients with severe baseline disease: {severe_patients}')
print(f'Fraction with severe baseline disease: {fraction_severe}')"}
